reasons: The rule's preferred position is the absence of any non-solicit binding the Customer; the cited paragraphs (§10 confidentiality use restriction, §13.5 IP/employee NDA warranty, §14.5 independent contractor, Exhibit D §5 staffing) contain no solicitation, no-hire or inducement restriction, so a 'compliant' classification is correct rather than 'missing'.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline was rendered (the redline text is identical to the originals) and no counterparty comment was proposed, as expected for internal evidence only.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are inapplicable artefacts where no restrictive covenant exists, and the rationale correctly notes the fallback terms to invoke if the counterparty later proposes one.
